To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the mean firing rate of the cell is a good predictor of the mean firing rate for the cell in the future, and that the mean rate of a cell is not a good predictor of its mean rate in the past; (2) the mean rate for a cell is not correlated with that of any other cell; (3) the mean rate of one cell is correlated with that of a second cell if they are both connected to a third cell.

the firing patterns of neurons can be described as point processes, that these point processes can be modeled as Poisson processes, and that the firing patterns can be described in terms of the mean rate, the variance of the rate, and the correlation of the rate.

the spike train data of a single cell is best described by a renewal process and that the spike train of a pair of cells is best described by an inhomogeneous Poisson process with the intensity function being a function of the spike trains of both cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the statistical analysis of data collected simultaneously from several neurons.
the development of statistical methods for analyzing the firing times of neurons in the brain.
the statistical analysis of the data of spike trains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the firing times of nerve cells are not independent and identically distributed.
the data are not random, but the details of the structure are not clear.
the likelihood approach, as implemented in the present work, provides the best way to analyze the data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the likelihood approach is the most powerful and most useful.

we have found that the firing times of nerve cells are not random, and that the degree of nonrandomness is related to the number of cells in the sample, the number of cells recorded simultaneously, the number of events, and the length of the sample period.
the likelihood method provides an excellent tool for the analysis of such data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the likelihood method is a powerful tool for data analysis.
the likelihood function, which is the natural way to analyze such data in a statistical sense, is a useful way of summarizing the data and of providing a basis for inference and hypothesis testing.
a likelihood-based approach to analysis is most appropriate.
